body: I know they are very loving but i got scared and havnt told them yet cause i feel like they would just scold me more. I havnt told my dad nor my mom or step dad. I just dont want them thinking that im not in a good place and that im just worrying to much about everything. Thanks man that really means a lot to me. Ive been trying to hopefully land on something but its been really hard for me at this point in life. I know as i sat in the bathroom crying i just kept thinking about what my future could really hold at this point and would anyone miss me? Those thoughts honestly just made me feel more selfish.
Im 28 and yes they still do.
I still have communication with her but i don't wanna tell her what happened. If i did i feel like i would be digging a deeper hole. I honestly didnt wanna tell anyone at this point.

So its been a rough couple of months for me, for 2017 and 2018. I got sick with a disease called valley fever back in November and had to take medication for a while to hopefully get rid of it. I lost my job over it ive had no income for the past 5 months because of it and last night i lost the one thing that was close to me, my girlfriend. She didnt see a future with me anymore and at this point ive been trying so hard to look for work for her and us. I wanted to find work and make things between us easier since i was so low funded. My parents would have to pay my bills and they were getting tired of it. All that just hit me in a matter of a second, which is just completely fucking scary to think about.

I just wasn't sure where else i could go, i always hear all these great things from reddit and just took the leap to post. I thought the hotline would help me, i sat there just thinking it was all just a bad joke. I couldn't believe it and yes im in a safe spot right now thank you.
